episodes.title: Kenyan Doomsday Cult Leader Paul Mackenzie Found Guilty! | NDTV World
episodes.description:
A Kenyan court in Mombasa has convicted doomsday cult leader Paul Mackenzie and 28 of his followers over the mass murder of 190 children and one adult at a remote forest compound. Prosecutors said Mackenzie used his Good News International Church to order families to fast unto death to meet Jesus. Sentencing is scheduled for November 6, and separate terrorism trials are still ongoing.

What You Need to Know:
- The verdict: the judge said the prosecution had proved its case against all 29 accused for the murder of 190 children and one adult.
- The case: prosecutors said Mackenzie used his Good News International Church to brainwash families, ordering followers to fast unto death; children were starved first and guards beat followers who tried to flee or find food.
- The defence: the accused argued the victims, all under 16, fasted voluntarily; the court rejected it.
- The graves: mass graves were found in 2023; forensic teams have exhumed over 400 bodies from the same forest compound.
- What next: sentencing on November 6 in Mombasa, with a maximum of life in prison; separate terrorism trials continue, with manslaughter and child torture charges pending.
- Anchor: Arjun Samar Mahendran, World Report on NDTV World.

episodes.title: Andrew Tate Arrested | Andrew, Tristan Tate Arrested In US Over UK Sex Crime Charges
episodes.description:
Influencer brothers Andrew and Tristan Tate, whose social media empire promoting wealth, male dominance and misogyny has made them among the world's most polarizing internet personalities, were arrested Saturday in Miami as British authorities sought their extradition on rape and sex trafficking charges.

The brothers were taken into custody by the U.S. Marshals Service on a sealed warrant, agency spokesperson Brady McCarron told The Associated Press, placing the United States at the center of an international legal saga that has stretched from Romania to Britain.
